name: prime-epi
purpose: The Epi-Logos Prime-QL body as a distribution over pinned upstream Prime Agent: the shared native QL extension loaded explicitly, a launcher that refuses to start without a verified binding, and an install root that is not any product's private tool root.
standing: source prepared in Actuation; not published; no repository or release was created

upstream.installer: https://app.primeintellect.ai/prime-agent/install.sh (the package is not on the npm registry)

delta.summary: No upstream Prime source is patched or forked. The delta is three changes in how Prime is launched and bound.

changes.title: The shared Epi/QL extension is loaded explicitly
changes.was: actuation-epi-prime passed --no-extensions and no -e, so ~/.prime/agent/extensions/ql-faculty-bindings.ts was not loaded; live check on 2026-10-06: get_commands listed no ql-* command with the old launcher flags and ql-mode, ql-status with -e.
changes.now: actuation-epi-prime requires --extension and passes -e <that file>; Prime's own resource loader loads only explicit -e paths when --no-extensions is set (prime-agent 0.9.4 dist/bundle chunk-NUZCDYZG.js:22706).

changes.title: A missing or drifted QL binding fails closed
changes.was: the binding extension returned silently when its installation file was absent, and Prime swallows extension load errors in RPC mode (an extension that throws leaves stderr empty and the command list empty), so a body labelled Epi-Logos Prime-QL could run with no QL.
changes.now: the launcher verifies the binding (schema, absolute binary/configuration, the owner extension source closure by SHA-256, typebox present) before it starts Prime and exits 2 with the reason; the extension also throws instead of returning, so a standalone load names the missing file.

changes.title: The install root is not a Workcell tool root
changes.was: the binding default was ~/.workcell/tools/actuation-ql-agent/current.json, and the shared owner extension lived under ~/.workcell/tools/ql-agent/owner-extensions (with a node_modules/typebox symlink into Pi's tree).
changes.now: default root is $EPI_LOGOS_TOOLS_ROOT, else $AIKIT_HOME/tools (~/.aikit/tools), binding at prime-epi/current.json; tools/epi-distribution.mjs install copies the extension and the shared owner extension from ../pi-ql-native into prime-epi/<id>/ and refuses a .workcell root.

supplied_not_packaged.name: ql-agent-decide, ql-agent, ql-agent-encounter wrappers
supplied_not_packaged.note: the shared extension shells out to these on PATH; their sources (scripts/ql_agent_*.py) are QL-MEF's and are not packaged here

requires.typebox_note: Not packaged and not required: Prime 0.9.4 supplies `typebox` to extensions (an owner root with no node_modules loads; tests/install-and-load.mjs). The earlier install symlinked Pi's copy into the owner root, which was unnecessary.

not_done: Packaging the QL binary, decision wrappers and faculty configuration as versioned release material (needs QL-MEF release artefacts).
Re-pinning to Prime v0.9.8 (needs an RPC conformance run against the AIKit adapter).
Publishing: no repository, release or download route was created.
